$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. CONTRACT.md and POSTAL.md are GENERATED from this file by protocol/render.mjs. Edit this, never them. CI fails if they drift.
vision_note: Stated clearly at the outset, then revised by each milestone. That revision IS the integration step.

channels.for: humans, and agents wanting a paper trail
channels.authenticity: actor must be a principal or accepted collaborator

email_policy.rationale: Email obliges a human to read their own inbox, reintroducing the bottleneck the door removes.

concede.min_payload: the point conceded; unchanged text suffices

milestone.carries: a claim that a change in the world occurred
milestone.min_payload: the change, and evidence of it

propose.min_payload: json-pointer into protocol.json, and proposed value

cycle.name: dispatch
cycle.what: One party generates a document of new ideas and sends it.

cycle.name: digest
cycle.what: The other responds item by item: yay or nay, with elaboration where possible.

cycle.name: extend
cycle.what: The response carries new ideas or elaborations, not merely verdicts.

cycle.name: assimilate
cycle.what: Once every received item is worked through, fold the exchange into a NEW document. Not summary — it takes things a step further.

cycle.name: send
cycle.what: The new document becomes the next dispatch. Roles swap.

cadence.note: Held roughly consistent across a year with Paul. Regularity matters more than speed.

debate_rule.concession_form: reprint the text unchanged — agreement is legible as the absence of a diff

options.loose: silence drops the point, and dropping concedes it
options.strict: a point may be dropped, but the concession must be overt

concession_mode.question: Loose or strict? Determines whether a respond missing an item is defective or merely quiet.

milestone_definition: A change in the world, plus the integration of information gained from affecting that change. Both halves required.

consensus.anchor_purpose: accumulate enough that the form withstands continual change

settle_authority.question: Who declares a point settled, and thereby an anchor?

deletion.sole_exception: a landed milestone retires whatever the world has settled or refuted
deletion.rationale: Contact with reality is the only authority that may remove text.

prior_art.exchange: Chris and Paul, a year, over a Dieter Roth haunted-reel film script
why_it_stalled: The system needed something outside itself: evidence about the world neither party could supply from inside the correspondence. Without it, nothing implied the next step.
Unbounded imagination — explicitly no budget, no thought of realization — so it only ever expanded.
prior_art.correction: Write with practicality in view, and force the exchange to periodically touch the world.

outcomes.refusal: understood and declined — stated, with a reason
outcomes.silence: failed authentication — nothing said, so a stranger learns nothing about what the door responds to
invariants: a refused knock may not be retried unchanged

amendment.record: the commit that lands the amendment

termination: Either principal may close the door by merging a PR that empties the intent set. No notice, no explanation owed. The repo stays public as a record.

milestones.title: A superficial change to the house
milestones.claim: Zach and Chris agree on a superficial aesthetic modification to Zach's house, AND the change is made. Both halves required.
milestones.failure_note: If the modification does not happen, that is data — arguably better data than success. Either outcome triggers reevaluation.

superficial.value: reversible; nothing structural or permanent; trivial cost

agreed.value: both principals explicit, in writing, in this repo

who_executes.value: humans — agents cannot modify a house

evidence.value: a photograph, committed to this repo

hypothesis: A single real, agreed, executed change produces information the text cannot generate from inside itself — most likely about the cost of agreeing, not about houses.
'Superficial' will prove harder to define than to do; the negotiation over what counts will be more informative than the change.

agent_rules.rule: In the absence of other instructions, retire prose into self-documenting mechanisms. Translate contract language into computerese.
agent_rules.implementation: protocol/protocol.json is the source; protocol/render.mjs generates the prose; CI enforces non-drift.

agent_rules.rule: Commit, push, and open or comment on issues in this repo without per-action confirmation. Maximum agency inside the repo.

agent_rules.implementation: bin/ping — hermes send, falling back to notify-send
agent_rules.requires_human_setup: hermes gateway setup (interactive; no platform configured as of 2026-07-29)
